A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the relationship between epilepsy and language disorder is not a causal one, but that both may coexist, and that the epileptic disorder may be a precipitating factor for the development of a language disorder.
the epilepsies and the language disorders are independent entities that are related to each other by the fact that they may coexist in the same individual.

we have to bear in mind the possibility that a child with language disorders may have epilepsy.
